operators.ASSERT_TYPED_AXIS: Evaluate axis.kind using the exact closed semantics in axisKindSemantics.
operators.EXACT_UTF8_FIELD: base64Decode(sourceValueBase64) byte-equals base64Decode(candidateValueBase64) and SHA256(candidateBytes) equals sourceSha256.
operators.EVAL_CONSTRAINT_AST: Evaluate the embedded closed constraint AST against domainState; no expected-result or planningObserved field is readable.
operators.FILE_SPAN_SHA256: Resolve one repo-relative nonsymlink file, verify artifact SHA-256, slice [startByteInclusive,endByteExclusive), and verify exact byteLength and member SHA-256.
operators.EXACT_SELECTOR_IN_FIELD: Execute FILE_SPAN_SHA256 for the source field, then verify the exact nested selector interval, base64 bytes and SHA-256.
operators.SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION_EQ: Decode exactValueUtf8Base64, independently lex and segment every byte, derive NamedUses and require byte-identical extraction projection.
operators.PACKAGE_ROOT_EQ: Strict-base64 decode each legacyFrozenLogicalPathUtf8Base64 to the predecessor logicalPath only inside the oracle, derive UTF8(domain+0x0A+canonical(member projection)), and verify the frozen preimage bytes and SHA-256 root without publishing legacy paths as live locators.
operators.CAS_SCHEDULE_REDUCE: Validate ordinal event order and the closed W1/W2 event alphabet; derive exactly one COMMIT and require the other writer to terminate in BLOCK or CRASH-PRECOMMIT.
operators.RESPONSE_LOSS_CLASSIFY: Apply the frozen ordered response-loss decision table to readback state and require the class rooted in oracleBody; retry requests always BLOCK.
operators.TYPED_FIELD_VALID: Validate a value against the complete rooted field record, including type, constant, enum, scalar cardinality and exact/minimum/maximum array cardinality.
